metadata.description: Local marketplace for the agent-completion-chime Claude Code plugin — MCP server (9 tools to configure / preview / reset chime sounds) plus Stop & SubagentStop hooks that fire a per-agent chime on completion and an all-complete chime when the active set drains.

plugins.name: agent-completion-chime
plugins.description: Plays a macOS sound (Glass.aiff per agent, Hero.aiff when all parallel agents finish) on Claude Code Stop / SubagentStop and OpenClaw run completions. Exposes 9 MCP tools for configuration: chime_status, chime_list_sounds, chime_set_per_agent_sound, chime_set_all_complete_sound, chime_set_volume, chime_enable, chime_disable, chime_test, chime_reset_active.
